en: The postcard shows a historical black-and-white image of a street scene with several multi-story stone and brick buildings. The street is wide and lined with wooden fencing. Notable text at the top reads 'Sundsvall — Parti från Nybrogatan,' and there are signs visible for 'BENZIN' (gasoline) and a shop. The back of the postcard has the classic layout for writing and address, and identifies the publisher as AB Framåten & Westerlund, Sundsvall.
